subject: Data Analyst position at Maple Freight
body:
Dear Mr. Grant,

With the greatest respect, I humbly write about the Data Analyst position, whose post notes that the analytics team owns weekly freight forecasts. I would be most grateful for your esteemed consideration.

At Tidewater Freight I built the RTO forecasting model, and RTO fell from 18% to 13% over two quarters.

Might I request fifteen minutes at a moment convenient to you? Should another colleague own this hire, a name would be appreciated.

Yours faithfully,
